DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTRESTRICTIONS MICHAEL'SPROTESTANTEPISCOPALCHURCH,a/k/aST.MICHAEL'SCHURCH ("Owner"), a New York religious corporation having an address at 225 West 99th Street, New York, New York 10025, and IMICO METRO LLC (*Developer"), a Delaware limited liability company having an address c/o Extell Development Company, 800 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10022 (Owner and Developer being herein collectively called “Declarants"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee simple of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, designated as (i) part of Lots 24 and 29 in Block 1871 on the Tax Map of the City of New York and known by street address as 201-227 West 99th Street, New York, New York, and (ii) Lots 35 and 36 in Block 1871 on the Tax Map of the City of New.York and known by street address as 814-816 AmsterdamAvenue,NewYork,NewYork,whichlandismoreparticularlydescribedinExhibit A annexed hereto(the“Owner Land"); WHEREAS,Developer is the owner infeesimple of certain landin the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, designated as Lot 44 and part of Lots 24 and 29 in Block 1871 on the Tax Map of the City of New York and known by street address as 2628 Broadway, New York, New York, which land is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (the "Developer Land"); WHEREAS, pursuant to the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the "Resolution"), Declarants desire to create a single zoning lot (as defined in the Resolution) consisting of the Owner Land and the Developer Land (said land collectively referred to herein as the“Property"); and WHEREAS, all parties in interest (as defined in the Resolution) to the Property as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of Commonwealth Land Title Insurance Company, annexed hereto as Exhibit C have joined in this Declaration or have waived their right to do so. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises, and other valuable consideration, the Declarants, with intent to bind all persons in whom the Property is or shall hereafter be vested, do hereby declare the following: 1. The Property consists of interests in several lots of record, each of which is contiguous for more than ten linear feet with the other lots on their respective common boundaries.Said lots are located within a single block and are hereby declared to be a tract of land to be treated as one zoning lot for the purposes of the Resolution (the “Combined Zoning Lot").  2. No breach by any party to this Declaration, or any agreement ancillary hereto, shall have any effect on the treatment of the Property as one zoning lot for purposes of the 1307808.4 1
